diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status-check, not an independent build failure. Its only failing step exits 1 when an upstream required job fails. The frozen latest-dependency job failed in the PR's new Redisson callback test; fixing that test addresses this aggregate failure too. The workflow's dependency/result conditions are in .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-91. No workflow change or rerun-only recommendation is warranted.

The PR's reentrantFailureCallbackKeepsClientErrorFallback test installs a blocking EVAL command mapper before creating its additional Redisson client. Pinned Redisson 4.8.0 synchronously runs an EVAL cluster-detection probe during client initialization. The mapper blocks that probe before the test can release its latch, producing a timeout and an unexpected root trace. The intended parent/EVAL/GET/SET trace already has the correct server prefix, exception-class fallback and successful SET in the frozen log. The candidate keeps all commands unchanged until Redisson.create completes, then arms the original EVAL gate and GET failure. A source-derived mapper regression reproduces the original timeout and passes with the fix; standard baseline compilation, shared-module checks and all seven helper unit tests pass. Full Docker-backed integration was not run; latest-dependency Gradle validation was blocked by an unrelated JDK 27 toolchain download certificate failure, with details in diagnostics.

Record Redis server-error prefixes as `error.type` on Redisson spans and database duration metrics, including errors mapped to dedicated exception subclasses, such as `OOM`.

Capture prefixes directly from RESP error replies before completion callbacks run. Preserve case and punctuation without an allowlist or length cap; client-side failures and replies without a captured prefix retain exception-class fallback.
